title: Canonical coefficient comparison, Steps 7--10
statement: For l prime, E a finite extension of Q_l, K0 any field in which l is invertible, positive levels m <= n, and f a separated finite-type map between finite-type K0-schemes, every compactification c and intrinsically bounded constructible K whose actual ordinary derived m-reduction is bounded constructible have invertible canonical B-linear compact-support coefficient map. The map is the scalar-adjunction transpose of compact support of the scalar unit followed by sfCompactSupportRestriction. No Tor amplitude or separate constructibility/interval conclusion is asserted.

proof.text: Use arbitrary finite-ring constructible derived origin to realize K as comparison pullback of a bounded constructible etale complex G. Convert its finite cohomological support to an explicit interval and hence to a bounded-below object.

The normalized scalar/site isomorphism identifies comparison pullback of the actual etale reduction L_B G with the actual reduction of K. Reflect its cohomological interval through the exact faithful comparison. This supplies a bounded-below object GB equal to L_B G; no finite Tor hypothesis or choice of a new reduction is made.

The scalar-transport theorem identifies the specified compact-support scalar transpose at the origin with the explicit isomorphism built from the proper finite-coefficient scalar mate and the open left-adjoint uniqueness comparison. Thus it is invertible at the origin. Adjunction naturality makes the scalar transpose a natural transformation, and conjugation by the input isomorphism gives invertibility at K.

proof_origin.place: Etale origin, interval reflection for the actual reduction, normalized scalar transport, and naturality

theorem finiteCompactSupportScalarComparison
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (K₀ : Type u) [Field K₀] (_hl : IsUnit (l : K₀))
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hmn : m ≤ n)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of K₀))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of K₀))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of K₀))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of K₀))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of K₀))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of K₀))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of K₀))]
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (c : Compactification f)
    (K : proEtaleDerivedCategory X (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E n))
    (hK : intrinsicFiniteTorsionConstructible l E n hn X K) :
    let := Padic.finite_coefficientExtensionRing l E n hn
    let := Padic.finite_coefficientExtensionRing l E m hm
    let φ := Ideal.Quotient.factor
      (S := Padic.coefficientExtensionIdeal l E n)
      (T := Padic.coefficientExtensionIdeal l E m) (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right hmn)
    let ρ := fun T : Scheme.{u} ↦
      (constantSheaf (ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1}).map
        (CommRingCat.ofHom (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1} φ))
    intrinsicFiniteTorsionConstructible l E m hm X ((pbcDerivedExtend (ρ X)).obj K) →
    IsIso (((pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction (ρ Y)).homEquiv _ _).symm
      ((sfIntrinsicCompactSupport c (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E n)).map
          ((pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction (ρ X)).unit.app K) ≫
        (sfCompactSupportRestriction c φ).hom.app ((pbcDerivedExtend (ρ X)).obj K)))
